user.title: Connect to the pfSense firewall / router
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should authenticate to the pfSense REST API. Only one method is used per connection.

api_key.title: pfSense REST API — API key
api_key.description: Enter the base URL of the pfSense REST API (including the port, e.g. {example_url}) and an API key generated at System › REST API › Keys.

basic.title: pfSense REST API — username and password
basic.description: Enter the base URL of the pfSense REST API (including the port, e.g. {example_url}) and a pfSense local user's credentials. HTTP Basic authentication must be enabled at System › REST API › Settings.

jwt.title: pfSense REST API — JWT
jwt.description: Enter the base URL of the pfSense REST API (including the port, e.g. {example_url}) and a pfSense local user's credentials. Home Assistant obtains and refreshes a JWT from them. JWT authentication must be enabled at System › REST API › Settings.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check the credentials, and that this method is enabled at System › REST API › Settings
error.privilege_missing: The account lacks the privileges required for this integration
error.api_not_found: REST API not found at that URL - check the address, the port, and that the REST API package is installed

abort.wrong_device: The credentials belong to a different pfSense device

data.rule_switch_kill_states: Reset matching states when a rule switch is toggled

device_tracker.description: Choose which devices you want to track.
